description: Rows of linked seats face a long window onto the apron, where the charters taxi past. A snack machine, a drinks machine and a coffee machine stand along the back wall under a departures screen. Security is north and Gate 1 south.

window.description: A long pane onto the apron. Tyre marks, a fuel bowser, and the boarding stair at Gate 1.
